# Ron Systems AI

> Ron Systems AI is the IT systems, automation and AI consultancy of Rolando "Ron" Tactay, an engineer with 11+ years in IT, including four years of 24/7 production support for global financial software. It helps small and medium businesses automate manual work, adopt practical AI, and set up reliable systems. Vendor-neutral; clients own everything built. Contact: {{ contact_email }}
